name: Alphamon
main_effect:
[Security] At the end of the battle, add this card to your hand. Then, if a Digimon with the [Royal Knight] or [X Antibody] trait is in play, up to 12 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack players for the turn.
[When Attacking] You may pay up to 5 memory. If you do, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn for each memory paid.
[End of Attack] Gain 2 memory.
